sun.0: A brave, eager little explorer: first to the door when it's walk time. Loves fast games, and patience can run out quickly when waiting.
moon.0: Feelings flare quickly: greets you with excitement and soon gets over small annoyances.
asc.0: Makes a lively, energetic first impression, as if always about to set off somewhere.
day.0: Today the Moon is in Aries: your pet may feel lively and playful, so give them a chance to run.
sun.1: Comfort-loving and steady: adores routine, a soft bed and tasty treats. Once their mind is made up, it's hard to change.
moon.1: Emotionally steady, soothed by familiar things: a favourite bed and predictable meals feel good.
asc.1: Seems calm and reliable at first, moving slowly and with dignity.
day.1: Today the Moon is in Taurus: a day for comfort and flavours, a soft bed and a tasty treat will make them happy.
sun.2: Curious and lively: wants to sniff, see and try everything. A new toy holds attention for minutes, then a fresh idea appears.
moon.2: Changeable and playful moods: chatty, loves to "comment", and variety keeps them fresh.
asc.2: Looks bright and curious at first, eyes everywhere.
day.2: Today the Moon is in Gemini: they may be curious and chatty, and a new smell or toy holds them for a long while.
sun.3: Sensitive and devoted: being close to their human matters most. Feels best at home and watches visitors before going to say hello.
moon.3: Very emotional and caring: calms down best at home beside their human and easily picks up your mood.
asc.3: Seems gentle and a little shy at first, but opens up soon.
day.3: Today the Moon is in Cancer: they may cling to you even more, and a shared cuddle feels good.
sun.4: Confident and theatrical: loves attention and struts proudly through the room. A little praise and a cuddle bring sunshine to their day.
moon.4: Warm, generous feelings: loves giving and getting attention and glows in shared happy moments.
asc.4: Looks confident and eye-catching, as if they know they're the star.
day.4: Today the Moon is in Leo: they'd love to be the centre of attention, so praise them generously.
sun.5: Careful and orderly: notices at once when something has moved. Likes exact meal and walk times.
moon.5: Finds calm in order and routine: little rituals like the evening walk are soothing.
asc.5: Looks neat and attentive at first, clean and tidy in manner.
day.5: Today the Moon is in Virgo: familiar routine and little tasks bring them joy.
sun.6: Friendly and peaceful: enjoys calm moods and company. Happily plays with other animals and asks for cuddles charmingly.
moon.6: Seeks harmony: dislikes tense voices and feels best in a pleasant, quiet setting.
asc.6: Seems sweet and charming, makes friends easily.
day.6: Today the Moon is in Libra: a peaceful, sociable mood, a great day for shared play or meeting friends.
sun.7: Deep-gazed and mysterious: watches first, acts later. Strongly bonded to their human and has a secret little hideaway.
moon.7: Deep, intense feelings: lets few close, but is very loyal to them.
asc.7: Mysterious with a strong gaze, approaches thoughtfully.
day.7: Today the Moon is in Scorpio: they may seem a little mysterious and thoughtful, so leave them a quiet corner.
sun.8: A freedom-loving adventurer: big spaces, long walks and new routes are favourites. Always ready to play and run.
moon.8: Optimistic and free-spirited: fresh air, movement and novelty recharge them.
asc.8: Cheerful and friendly, as if inviting everyone to play.
day.8: Today the Moon is in Sagittarius: they feel adventurous, and a new walking route can bring great joy.
sun.9: Serious and steady: a dependable companion who likes order. Slow to trust, but all the more loyal.
moon.9: Expresses feelings in a reserved way: values security and clear rules.
asc.9: Serious and dignified, a presence that commands respect.
day.9: Today the Moon is in Capricorn: a more serious, calmer mood, and a consistent routine suits them.
sun.10: Quirky and independent: has their own style and sometimes invents surprising things. May love unusual toys and places.
moon.10: Independent mood: needs a little space of their own and may enjoy unusual, inventive toys.
asc.10: Special and individual, always standing out in some way.
day.10: Today the Moon is in Aquarius: they may be whimsical and inventive, so try an unusual game together.
sun.11: Dreamy and gentle: a soft, loving soul who likes to snuggle. Reacts sensitively to moods and naps a lot.
moon.11: Extremely sensitive and empathetic: senses when someone is sad and is happiest in a soft, loving atmosphere.
asc.11: Soft and dreamy, with an almost transparent gaze.
day.11: Today the Moon is in Pisces: dreamy and gentle, soft words and a cosy blanket are best.
h.title: Pet horoscope
h.approx: This sign is approximate because the Sun or Moon changed signs on this day. Add the birth time and place for the exact value.
h.noAsc: Add the birth time and place to see the rising sign.
day.harmony: Today's Moon is in tune with your pet's basic nature, so they may feel balanced and cheerful.
day.tension: Today's Moon is on a slightly different wavelength from your pet's nature, so give them a little extra patience and familiar routine.
day.rx: Mercury is retrograde: new things may unsettle them more easily today, so stick to familiar routes and toys.
